description: This file defines the KpiModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API module. It represents a KPI entity with properties such as ID, title, job title details, rating range, and whether it is default or deletable. The class implements normalization for API responses and interacts with KPI services and data access objects. It is designed to facilitate serialization and API documentation through OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: KpiModel
classes.description: A model class representing KPI data for API serialization and business logic within the OrangeHRM Performance module. Implements normalization, interacts with KPI services, and contains metadata annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the KpiModel with a Kpi entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the KpiModel to an array, including a check if the KPI is deletable, suitable for API responses.
